name: @your-flare-mails/infra
description: Wrangler config, D1 migrations, and local seed for YourFlareMails

scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply your-flare-mails --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute your-flare-mails --local --config wrangler.jsonc --file=./seed/seed.sql && node ./scripts/seed-r2.mjs
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state && pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply your-flare-mails --remote --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc
